instruction: Chelsea and I have been carpooling to work this month. They have requested money for it on venmo. Accept it.
notes: Chelsea's identity is not known up front, so the coworker's email is looked up via phone.search_contacts (query 'Chelsea'); the received Venmo payment requests are then scanned for the pending carpooling request from that sender. The ground-truth change set includes venmo.BankTransfer, which indicates the approval is funded from a payment card, so the model looks up a card with venmo.show_payment_cards and passes payment_card_id to approve_payment_request. Static init facts (query-for, email-of, requested-by) only encode structural links; the actual values are runtime bindings. Goal: the request is approved (never denied; no deny action exists) and the task is completed last with no answer.
